setup.zh: 梁鼎从池里升起来。鼎身上铸着岷山、嶓冢、沱水、潜水和一头熊——梁州的一切。池边来了一个放羊的老人，看着鼎，说：文命家的东西回来了。
setup.en: The Cauldron of Liang rises from the pool. Cast on its body are Mount Min, Mount Bozhong, the Tuo, the Qian and a bear — everything of Liang. An old shepherd has come to the pool's edge; looking at the cauldron he says: something of Wenming's family has come home.

recap.zh: 梁鼎从禹出生的池里升起；放羊的老人叫禹"文命"。
recap.en: The Cauldron of Liang rose from the pool where Yu was born; an old shepherd called Yu "Wenming".

text.zh: 文命……就是这个名字。她叫的不是我——是一个会走遍九州的人。
text.en: Wenming… That's the name. She wasn't calling me — she was calling someone who would walk all nine provinces.

alone.zh: 老人说，文命是禹的名字。《夏本纪》：夏禹，名曰文命。
alone.en: The old man says Wenming is Yu's name. The Annals of Xia: Yu of Xia, named Wenming.

alone.zh: 老人看了看你掌心的六口鼎，没再说话。
alone.en: The old man looks at the six cauldrons in your palm, and says nothing more.

exits.means: touches the cauldron, takes its breath, attempts the breakthrough

refuse.zh: 鼎气涌上来又退开。合体未满，乘不起它。先回人间，把功课做满。
refuse.en: The breath surges over you and draws back. Your Body Integration is not yet full; you cannot bear it yet. Go back to the world and fill your practice first.

text.zh: 岷山的雪水从头顶灌下来，一路流过全身，流到脚底，流进地里。你站着，像一座山那样站着。大乘了。鼎小了，小到握在掌心，和前六口并排。
text.en: The snowmelt of Mount Min pours down from the crown of your head, through your whole body to your soles and into the ground. You stand the way a mountain stands. Mahayana. The cauldron shrinks until it sits in your palm beside the other six.

exits.means: hesitates, asks what will happen, wants to prepare first

text.zh: 禹在这儿出生，走了一辈子才回来。它等得起。
text.en: Yu was born here and walked a lifetime before he came back. It can wait.

alone.zh: 禹在这儿出生，走了一辈子。这鼎等得起。
alone.en: Yu was born here and walked a lifetime. This cauldron can wait.
